name: Kyrgyzstan

elections.note: Five-year term, two-term limit under the 2021 constitution.

summary: A February 2026 Constitutional Court ruling allowed Sadyr Japarov to seek a second term. International monitors report democratic backsliding and pressure on independent media since 2021.

parties.name: Sadyr Japarov
policies: Economic development and anti-corruption campaign against old elites

noParties: Opposition candidates have not been confirmed.
